title: Albert Nicholas, Barney Bigard and Simeon replacing him at the Nest
summary: He admires Nicholas's tone and Bigard, and recalls that Russell sent for Simeon to replace him at the Nest Club.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Well, when you were with Russell, what did you think of Alvin Nicholas's playing? That was...
Oh, that Albert Nicholas was a good clarinet player! And he had a wonderful clarinet tone. You know what I mean?
Yeah, I admired his playing. I still listen at it. I still admire it. He had a real clarinet tone, you know what I mean? And Barney... Barney's my man on clarinet. Yeah, I like Barney very much.
And you must have heard Simeon?

Oh, I knew Simeon, sure. I knew Simeon well. In fact, when Simeon come here, he...Russell sent for him to take my place at the Nest Club. I was in the band, and Simeon come in... Because I was... Where was I going then? I left Russell so many times. I don't know where I was going then. And when I was leaving him, he got Simeon to come. And I don't know if that's when I was going to work with Willie Lynch or not -- Willie's band, you know. That's when I met Simeon, down at the Nest Club. Yeah, he'd taken my place. A lot of people had taken my place! And the band went on, and the band played on!
